title: Page heading of Runs: recent agent turns (a socio's replies to a message, with the steps they took).
description: Text under the heading for a member; the admin form is for admins, who see the whole team's turns. A trace lists a turn's steps.
tabs.label: Accessible name of the page's tab list; the tabs show only when other modules add tabs beside Turns.
tabs.turns: Tab with the turns; other modules may add tabs.
filter.label: Accessible name of the status filter.
filter.failed: Option in the status filter above the turns table: show only the turns that failed.
filter.interrupted: Option in the status filter above the turns table: show only turns with this status.
filter.stopped: Option in the status filter above the turns table: show only turns with this status.
filter.running: Option in the status filter above the turns table: show only turns with this status.
filter.finished: Option in the status filter above the turns table: show only turns with this status.
latest: Beside the filter, when the list is cut at {{count}} turns.
columns.status: Column heading: the turn's status; clicking the status opens the turn's trace.
columns.owner: Column heading: whose conversation it is.
columns.source: Column heading: where the turn came from.
columns.started: Column heading: when the turn started (a date and time).
columns.duration: Column heading: how long the turn took.
status.running: A turn's status beside a colored dot.
status.finished: A turn's status beside a colored dot.
status.stopped: A turn's status beside a colored dot.
status.failed: A turn's status beside a colored dot.
status.interrupted: A turn's status beside a colored dot.
source.web: Where a turn came from: the web app, Telegram (a name, not to translate), a scheduled task, or a voice call.
source.telegram: Where a turn came from: the web app, Telegram (a name, not to translate), a scheduled task, or a voice call.
source.scheduled: Where a turn came from: the web app, Telegram (a name, not to translate), a scheduled task, or a voice call.
source.voice: Where a turn came from: the web app, Telegram (a name, not to translate), a scheduled task, or a voice call.
trace: Accessible name of the button that opens a turn's trace in place; {{title}} is its conversation's title. The open form closes it.
this-turn: Stands in for the title when the conversation has none.
room: After the owner: the turn was in a room (a shared chat; product noun Room).
empty: Shown when there are no turns.
empty-filtered.failed: Shown when no turn has the status filtered on.
empty-filtered.interrupted: Shown when no turn has the status filtered on.
empty-filtered.stopped: Shown when no turn has the status filtered on.
empty-filtered.running: Shown when no turn has the status filtered on.
empty-filtered.finished: Shown when no turn has the status filtered on.
